Dan,
	What do we need to do to make sure these accounts stay active past Sunday?

Dave

-----Original Message-----
From: Belden, Tim 
Sent: Wednesday, February 06, 2002 10:04 AM
To: O'Neil, Murray P.; Steiner, David; Williams III, Bill
Subject: RE: FW: Disabling EST Accounts


It is in the best interest of the Estate to keep these accounts active until the Estate has a solid alternative plan established!

-----Original Message-----
From: O'Neil, Murray P. 
Sent: Wednesday, February 06, 2002 9:23 AM
To: Steiner, David; Williams III, Bill; Belden, Tim
Subject: Re: FW: Disabling EST Accounts


Dave,

We are currently working on options to have the roles each of the resources you have identified performed by the resources in the Estate.  However, I do not feel that the accounts for the resources should be disabled.  There are possible situations where we will need to call on them for coverage and assistance in this transition.  I have not heard from anyone yet as to the expected transition time frame.  We are trying to get all issues resolved as quickly as possible.

Please respond is anyone has a different view.

Thanks - MO
